_comment: Recall of our own relevance filter over the pools in ./fixtures-pool, which are captured BEFORE the filter runs. Regenerate deliberately (node scripts/reportPoolRecall.mjs --write-baseline) and review the diff — a floor that falls means the matcher started discarding products it used to keep. Never re-baseline to make a red build green.
_floorsComment: Per-query floors, so a change cannot raise the mean by helping easy queries while destroying one. A low floor can still mean the LABELS are generous rather than the filter wrong — freilandeier counts any plain egg — so read a floor against goldenSet.ts before raising the matcher to chase it.
_labelCorrectionComment: 2026-08-06, two changes on the same day, measured separately and in this order. (1) LABELS corrected in goldenSet.ts, ranker untouched: meanRecall 0.871 -> 0.867, obst 1.00 -> 0.916, ruebli 0.265 -> 0.150. Those falls were not the filter getting worse — the DENOMINATORS grew to the honest set of products. obst went from 15 labelled relevant to 24 (Aprikosen, Datteln, Feigen, Nektarine, Pfirsich, Pflaumen, Physalis, Passionsfrucht, Pitahaya, Sultaninen had all been unjudged, while Hipp baby cereal, two Früchtequarks and three fruit bars were counted as fruit); ruebli had been counting Rüebli biscuits, a Rüebli cake, a carrot-orange-ginger juice and Betty Bossi marzipan carrots as the vegetable. That exposed two real filter defects the bad labels had hidden. (2) MATCHER fixed, labels untouched: meanRecall 0.867 -> 0.888, and it is now above the 0.871 that was ever measured under the wrong labels. ruebli 0.150 -> 1.000, obst 0.916 -> 1.000, kartoffeln 0.859 -> 1.000. Cause: HYPERNYMS conflated two lexical relations. It is directional on purpose, so 'Apfel' cannot match a banana — correct for SIBLINGS. But 'rueebli' appeared only as a VALUE under gemuse and never as a key, so it expanded to nothing, and since an unrecognised token is mandatory that DISQUALIFIED every carrot: the query kept the biscuits and dropped Migros Karotten, Snack Karotten, Baby Karotten and Erbsen und Karotten. Rüebli and Karotte are not siblings, they are the same vegetable in two dialects. Fixed with a separate symmetric SYNONYM_GROUPS table (ISO 25964-1 keeps equivalence USE/UF apart from hierarchy BT/NT; Lucene has SynonymQuery apart from taxonomy rewrites), scored at the direct band 80/60 rather than the hypernym discount 40/30 per Lucene's rule that a true synonym satisfies the query as fully as the literal word. 'Apfel' -> 'Bananen' is still 0, asserted by a test. STILL OPEN, and now visible rather than hidden: ruebli P@5 over this pool is 0.00 — the actual carrots are admitted at strength 80 but every Rüebli cake, biscuit and marzipan scores 90 off the whole-name bonus and buries them. That is a PRECISION defect of the same family as item 2's hypernym problem, written up in the tracker.
